work_items.title: Pin one legally obtained Skyrim executable
work_items.acceptance: Record store, actual version, x86-64 architecture, SHA-256 and scope notes; no game bytes.

work_items.title: Reproduce Ghidra types and address import
work_items.acceptance: Record tool/archive revisions and validate representative types and address mappings on the selected build.

work_items.title: Prove a Windows compiler worker
work_items.acceptance: Compile a synthetic fixture, identify Skyrim compiler candidates, and record exact tools and VM compatibility.

work_items.title: Validate Boat as an x64 build worker
work_items.acceptance: Synthetic exact-MSVC compile under Wine, recorded toolchain, cost limit and cleanup; no proprietary uploads without separate authorization.

work_items.title: Implement and review the matching gate
work_items.acceptance: Use synthetic negative fixtures for bytes, relocations, calls, data references and exception coverage; reproduce locally before enabling matches; the gate change passes its own Reviewer pass under the acceptance rule. So far: gate implemented in tools/check.py with a Reviewer record and negative tests, run as the CI consistency check; the first real comparison is reproduced on more than one host. The gate passed its Reviewer pass after four fix rounds.

work_items.title: Recover and verify the first small function
work_items.acceptance: Accept one small function under the acceptance rule: reproduced comparator pass, a fresh Reviewer approve recorded by tools/accept_function.py, and sanitized reproducible evidence. So far: 0x73ad90 reconstructed, integrated and reproduced on 3 hosts; Reviewer approved; accepted as matched.

work_items.title: Investigate movement-type selection
work_items.acceptance: Separate observed behavior from inference, and produce a reviewed behavior specification with synthetic cases.

milestones.title: Research repository scaffolded
milestones.detail: Agent guidance, publication policies, research templates and a versioned progress report created. No target or match claims.

milestones.title: Target executable pinned
milestones.detail: Steam SkyrimSE.exe 1.7.104.0 (build id sse-steam-1-7-104) fingerprinted locally by SHA-256. Metadata only; no function analysis or matching yet.

milestones.title: Ghidra import and address-mapping anchors checked
milestones.detail: Pinned image imported and analyzed in Ghidra 12.2; Address Library 1.7.104.0 mapping checked against the image. RTTI vtable and type-descriptor ids agree (8,013 of 8,015; 7,319 of 7,321), with 4 identity failures and 1 unexplained case; function identity is supported only for about 20 individually checked anchors. One host, one run; no matches or completion figures claimed.

milestones.title: Compiler worker reproduced on Boat with synthetic code
milestones.detail: MSVC cl 19.16.27054 (VS 2017 15.9 Build Tools) under Wine on one Boat machine compiled original synthetic C++ with identical code across clean builds; the comparator passed five synthetic functions and rejected three negative cases. Establishes a worker only: not shown to be the game's original compiler, nothing compared against the game, setup not yet repeated on a second machine.

milestones.title: First function accepted as byte-matched
milestones.detail: ArmorRatingVisitor::HaveNotVisitedArmor (community name, unverified), RVA 0x73ad90, 84 bytes: comparator pass with full code and unwind coverage reproduced on 2 compile hosts and 3 compare hosts with partial independence, plus a Reviewer approve. A byte match of the checked code only; scope is still undefined, so no completion percentage.

milestones.title: Six functions accepted as byte-matched
milestones.detail: Five more functions of varied shape (calls, a global read, floating point, a loop with branches) reconstructed by Sonnet drafters with one-command attempts, reproduced on two compile hosts and approved in one batch review; the first function was re-confirmed after its unit was extended. 595 bytes in total. The second host is a disk fork of the first, so host independence is partial. Scope is still undefined.
